Types

8 common QR types supported

Covering 90% of daily use cases

URL

Scan to open websites, app stores, videos, maps directly.

vCard

Scan to save contact to phone address book, replace paper cards.

Plain Text

Show any text content (up to 300 chars), for notes and descriptions.

Email

Scan to open mail client with prefilled recipient, subject and body.

Phone

Scan to dial — perfect for customer service and emergency contacts.

SMS

Scan to send prefilled SMS — for events and check-in.

Wi-Fi Auto-Connect

Scan to connect to Wi-Fi without typing password — guest favorite.

Geo Coordinates

Scan to open map navigation — for offline stores.

FAQ

You might want to know

Can't find an answer?Contact

A QR code (Quick Response Code) is a two-dimensional barcode invented by Denso Wave in 1994. It can store URLs, text, contact cards, WiFi passwords and more. Compared to 1D barcodes, it offers higher capacity, better error tolerance, and faster scanning — widely used in mobile payments, product traceability, and marketing.

Yes, QR Tool Studio is completely free with no hidden charges. All features (custom colors, gradients, logo, batch generation, multi-format export) are free and no sign-up is required.

No. We generate static QR codes — once created, they work forever with no scan limits and will not break if any server goes down. We recommend downloading as PNG or SVG and keeping a backup.

Absolutely not. All QR code generation, rendering, and download happen locally in your browser. Content is never uploaded to any server. After closing the page, no residue remains except the LocalStorage history you actively saved.

We support 8 common types: URL, vCard, plain text, email (mailto:), phone (tel:), SMS (sms:), WiFi auto-connect, and geo coordinates. You can also paste any string directly.

Yes. We support PNG / JPG / SVG logo images, up to 2MB. The logo size can be adjusted between 10% and 50%. We recommend setting error correction to H (30%) to ensure scan success.

Not necessarily. This tool supports any foreground color, plus dual-color linear / radial gradients with 6 style presets. For best scan rate, maintain high color contrast (dark foreground + light background) and avoid inverted colors.

Three formats are supported: PNG (1024×1024 high-res bitmap, perfect for social sharing), SVG (vector, lossless scaling for print and large posters), JPEG (compressed bitmap for email attachments). You can also copy the image to your clipboard with one click.
